figures.Fig8.6: Parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma cells (micrographs and drawings). Original figure archived as c11-bio-ch8-fig-support-tissues (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The print lists 'fibres, sclereids and vessels' as the three types of sclerenchyma cell and calls fibres '(tracheids)'; kept as in print though vessels and tracheids are usually classed as xylem elements.
